requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Requirement is unambiguous and atomic. Structured as a single functional requirement, incorporating the specific frequency constraint from the controlled context.

structured_requirements.final_statement: The system shall generate a dial tone using simultaneous 350 Hz and 440 Hz, adhering to the North American telephony standard.
structuring_notes: The core action is 'Generate a dial tone' (Functional). The frequency specification (350 Hz and 440 Hz) is extracted from the controlled context constraint CST-01 and incorporated into the final statement to ensure completeness and adherence to standards.

unsupported_inferences_avoided: Did not assume the trigger for generating the dial tone, as none was specified in the base requirement text.
